contexts.text: I marvelled at the great abundance (of Evil Spirits in the World of Spirits).
To make abundance = to give to himself.
Whatever is an object of regard they shall have in abundance. Signified.
The abundance of ideas from Heaven is thus represented.
Thus was an opportunity given them.
Twelve fountains of water = truths in all abundance.
Seventy palm trees = goods of truth in all abundance.
When an opportunity is given. TCR 312:end.
For all ability there must be opportunity.
That men have abundant store according to the love of propagating truths of wisdom and according to the love of doing uses. General article.
This abundant store varies with them according to the states of their minds, and also of their bodies...
Occurs. TCR 352. TCR 364:3. TCR 374:3. TCR 428:end. TCR 455:3. TCR 491. TCR 524:3. TCR 701:2.
